newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Kern County, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Kern County, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to section 53692 of the California Government Code, that the Board of Supervisors of Kern County, California, in the name of the Kern High School District (the
sell, at public sale, $19,000,000 Kern High School District (Kern County, California) 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes. Bids will be received at 10:00 A.M., Pacific time, on

and, without further advertising, so long as a proposal has not theretofore been accepted by the Board, on any Thursday thereafter, at the offices of Dale Scott & Company, Inc., 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, California 94104, and the sale will be awarded by the County Treasurer- Tax Collector of the District within 26 hours after the expiration of the time prescribed for the receipt of bids. Further information, including copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form may be obtained from Dale Scott & Company, Inc. at the above address.
